accent-wipe (v1): stroke-dashoffset draw -> counter-translated clip wipe

keep the 5 slots mounted and update src in place (st5)

variants.limit: the win is in UpdateLayoutTree.elementCount, a quarantined counter; WebKit is source-only (Lean wk_units)
variants.name: scoped

variants.limit: the CSS animations replace the callback only for a settled entrance in a browser with animation-timeline and unreduced motion; before Safari 26.4 they run on the main thread; countdown hidden-pause reads the stage's inline --exit-opacity, which this variant clears
variants.name: threaded

variants.limit: while the nav morphs (is-morphing) the panel box keeps the nav's final size and each child is inset onto the nav box; the nav and the column tracks still change size every frame (colW_mono, pitch_scaled_ne), the children are still laid out per frame, and the panel layer's blur outset still varies while the fade runs (INFERRED)
variants.name: const-bounds

variants.limit: look change (L) during a trackpad gesture in flight: the pinned page no longer jitters and the overlay scrollbar hides while the morph runs; costs 2 root style passes per morph where it engages (hover input and overlay scrollbar); reads the scrollbar kind once per activation; on (hover: none) it is not installed and on classic scrollbars it never writes the root
variants.name: scroll-lock

variants.limit: look change (L) while the nav morphs: the earn button follows --morph without its 0.68 s lag; VisSame only at settled frames
variants.name: earn-no-transition

variants.limit: a covered frame after a note move still commits once, as in the original; skipping on empty extras alone is not E (Lean naive_not_E)
variants.name: visible-idem

variants.limit: Lean premise P1 (the c860 band is fixed per load) is not enforced: outside P1, a resize across c860 shows a multi-frame visible lerp of scale and radius from the stale frozen value (INFERRED)
variants.name: mq

variants.limit: phone band only: skips the --platform-shrink write while mq.c860 matches and writes the current value when the band is left; the saving may sit outside the felt end-of-page window (INFERRED)
variants.name: mq

variants.limit: one opacity and blur effect per push replaces the per-frame --morph-fade write; equal values under the WAAPI premises, but CA's blur is not the software blur (pixels at best Q on WebKit); the section's blur layer is tiled above 1280 px; Chromium keeps the blur on the main thread
variants.name: fade-threaded
